papers.title: Laurent Phenomenon Algebras on Minuscule Grassmannians and their Mirrors
papers.summary: Constructs Laurent phenomenon algebra structures on half-spin Grassmannians and the Freudenthal variety, and compares their explicit mirror algebras and theta bases with intrinsic mirrors.

papers.title: Arithmetic Kac Theory for Ramified Species
papers.summary: Extends Kac-style classification and counting of indecomposable representations to ramified species, connecting arithmetic splitting with root systems.

papers.title: Ramified convolution and monodromy bases for symmetrizable Kac–Moody algebras
papers.summary: Uses ramified representations and monodromy to construct integral bases for symmetrizable Kac–Moody algebras, recovering the semicanonical basis in the symmetric case.

papers.title: Ramified Quivers with Potentials, Monodromy Characters, and Cluster Bases I
papers.summary: Develops ramified representation models and monodromy cluster characters that produce bases for skew-symmetrizable cluster algebras under explicit hypotheses.

papers.title: Symmetric Branching via Laurent Phenomenon Algebras
papers.summary: Realizes several reductive branching algebras as Laurent phenomenon algebras and gives polyhedral formulas for branching multiplicities in specified cases.

papers.title: Syzygy Transformations of Cluster Characters and Geometric Twists
papers.summary: Shows how syzygy and suspension act on cluster characters in 2-Calabi–Yau settings. Relates these actions to geometric twists on Grassmannians, positroid varieties, and unipotent cells without requiring mutation reachability.

papers.title: Cluster Geometry of Universal Schubert Polynomials I: Geometric Bases and Cluster Monomials
papers.summary: Connects universal Schubert polynomials with geometric bases and characterizes when they become cluster monomials through a combinatorial condition.

papers.title: Cluster Algebras for Bosonic Plethysm
papers.summary: Builds cluster structures on invariant rings associated with symmetric squares and expresses plethysm coefficients through alternating sums of lattice-point counts.

papers.title: A Polyhedral Formula for n×2×2 Kronecker Coefficients via Cluster Algebras
papers.summary: Constructs a cluster model whose lattice-point counts give a nonnegative polyhedral formula for n×2×2 Kronecker coefficients.

papers.title: Flag Varieties of General Quiver Representations: Characteristic Classes and Semi-Invariants
papers.summary: Computes dimensions, characteristic classes, and Euler characteristics of flag schemes of general quiver representations. Expresses parabolic Schubert coefficients using semi-invariants of auxiliary quivers and gives localization formulas.
papers.journal: International Mathematics Research Notices, to appear

papers.title: On the Orthogonal Projections
papers.summary: Constructs projections onto perpendicular representation categories that preserve generic invariants and canonical decompositions, and develops mutation formulas and reduction procedures for quivers with potentials.

papers.title: Hessian Defect, Compatibility Degree, and Canonical Decomposition
papers.summary: Uses Hessian differentials to explain discrepancies between dimension and denominator vectors, distinguish cluster variables with identical denominators, and compute canonical multiplicities through compatibility pairings.

papers.title: Crystal Structure of Upper Cluster Algebras
papers.summary: Constructs crystal structures on tropical points of upper cluster algebras and relates their operators to representations, derivations, and compatible bases.

papers.title: On the General Ranks of QP Representations
papers.summary: Proposes a mutation formula for generic ranks between principal components of quiver-with-potential representations, proves it under reachability hypotheses, and identifies related mutation invariants.

papers.title: Mahler Measure of 3D Landau–Ginzburg Potentials
papers.summary: Computes Mahler measures for 23 families of Laurent polynomials arising from Fano threefolds, connects special values with modular L-functions, and finds ten relations among these measures.

papers.title: Tropical F-polynomials and General Presentations
papers.summary: Uses general presentations to describe tropical F-polynomials and Newton polytopes of quiver representations, with applications to cluster duality.
papers.journal: Journal of the London Mathematical Society 107 (2023), no. 6, 2079–2120

papers.title: Combinatorics of F-polynomials
papers.summary: Describes the Newton polytopes of F-polynomials and their restrictions to faces using stabilization functors. Determines facets for general representations of acyclic quivers and proves saturated support for rigid representations.

papers.title: Cluster Algebras, Invariant Theory, and Kronecker Coefficients II
papers.summary: Builds cluster models of flagged Kronecker semi-invariant rings and reduces the computation of Kronecker coefficients to lattice-point counts.

papers.title: Extending Upper Cluster Algebras
papers.summary: Studies when extending a quiver preserves an upper cluster algebra and its cluster model, with applications to semi-invariant rings of complete flag configurations and their polyhedral bases.

papers.title: Tensor Product Multiplicities via Upper Cluster Algebras
papers.summary: Realizes tensor-product multiplicities for simply-laced groups as graded dimensions of explicitly constructed upper cluster algebras.
papers.journal: Annales scientifiques de l’École normale supérieure 54 (2021), no. 6, 1415–1464

papers.title: Cluster Algebras and Semi-invariant Rings II. Projections
papers.summary: Shows how projection through an exceptional representation transfers upper cluster algebra structures between quiver semi-invariant rings by explicit operations on ice quivers. Quivers with potentials also describe the relationship between their bases.

papers.title: Cluster Algebras, Invariant Theory, and Kronecker Coefficients I
papers.summary: Connects truncated Kronecker products to semi-invariant rings of quiver representations and constructs cluster structures in the two-part case. Explicit g-vector cones express the relevant Kronecker coefficients as differences of lattice-point counts in rational polytopes.

papers.title: Cluster Algebras and Semi-invariant Rings I. Triple Flags
papers.summary: Realizes semi-invariant rings of complete triple flags as upper cluster algebras of ice hive quivers. Constructs bases from lattice points in a rational polyhedral cone and determines minimal generators in small cases.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society 115 (2017), no. 1, 1–32

papers.title: Counting using Hall Algebras III. Quivers with Potentials
papers.summary: Studies vanishing cycles for quivers with potentials through truncated Jacobian algebras. Wall-crossing yields a categorification of quantum cluster algebras under suitable assumptions, together with counting formulas for representation Grassmannians under sink-source reflections.

papers.title: Counting Using Hall Algebras I. Quivers
papers.summary: Uses the Hopf algebra structure of a quiver's Hall algebra to count points over finite fields in representation moduli spaces, quiver Grassmannians, and flag varieties, with applications to cluster algebras.

papers.title: Moduli of Representations I. Projections from Quivers
papers.summary: Uses orthogonal projection functors to relate moduli spaces of quiver representations to those for quivers with one fewer vertex, identifying blow-ups under suitable conditions and comparing stability and ample divisors.

papers.title: General Presentations of Algebras
papers.summary: Develops canonical decompositions of general presentations of finite-dimensional algebras and a simplicial complex organizing rigid presentations.
